qualification_rule: Qualified requires explicit execution authorization, exact asset-digest verification, every backend-neutral behavior passing with non-empty evidence, observed process/file/network/model-download effects, and successful cleanup. It never establishes production readiness.
live_bob_rule: A live Bob claim additionally requires the ibm_bob client, a recorded client version, explicit workspace trust, and a qualified backend trial.
evidence_boundary: This protocol validates a record. It does not authorize, install, download, configure, start, stop, or remove a backend or Bob client.
